captions.text: The Rescue Challenge: change the conditions yourself. Every outcome is calculated, not selected from a demo script.
Choose a simulated starting record: six prior reports. The saved assembly is isolated from this challenge.
Unexpected loss: center shelf C1, after six steps. The real engine withdraws reports 3 and 5; other work survives.
Inspect the actual dependency paths. Missing parts, prerequisites and recovery are returned by explain_recovery over MCP.
Compare two independent alternatives against the same record: missing C1 versus missing feet F1. Neither has been applied.
A preview cannot approve itself. Review the exact changes and every invalidated digital report before applying.
Recovering C1 keeps reports 1, 2, 4 and 6. It does not silently restore withdrawn confirmations.
For this digital replay, report the remaining steps individually. These confirmations do not verify physical furniture.
8/8 reports in the challenge record. The original 3D viewer follows engine state; saved user progress is unchanged.
Inspect tool names, exact arguments, latency and state fingerprints. Export the evidence and replay it in a fresh MCP session.
An official MCP Apps View: the host reads a ui:// resource and completes the SDK handshake. This tested host runs locally.
The same 3D rescue interface runs inside a sandboxed card. Its requests travel through App → AppBridge → real MCP.
The host adds a separate human approval boundary. The embedded card cannot tick this host checkbox.
Public preview: deterministic browser engine. Real MCP and MCP Apps: documented localhost setup. No LLM or native Alexa+ connection.

tools.name: preview_scenario
tools.description: Read-only counterfactual resource and progress analysis. Returns a validated hypothetical copy and exact base token; never changes actual inventory, confirmations or audit.

tools.name: compare_scenarios
tools.description: Compare one to six independent counterfactuals against the same actual snapshot using the real dependency planner.

tools.name: explain_recovery
tools.description: Read actual or hypothetical graph-derived resource requirements and prerequisite work. This does not certify physical safety or optimize repair order.

tools.name: apply_scenario
tools.description: Atomically apply reviewed resource changes and digital confirmation invalidation. Requires explicit client human approval and an exact unchanged base token; rejects stale proposals.

tools.name: load_assembly
tools.description: Load a catalog assembly in this isolated session. Resets this session only.

tools.name: get_assembly_state
tools.description: Read this session’s current assembly and action history.

tools.name: list_parts
tools.description: List original model parts and their inventory states.

tools.name: inspect_part
tools.description: Inspect and select a part by its identifier.

tools.name: explain_part_impact
tools.description: Compute the dependency impact of a hypothetical missing part without changing inventory.

tools.name: mark_part_missing
tools.description: Report a missing part and invalidate dependent assembly steps.

tools.name: restore_part
tools.description: Report a recovered part and recompute valid next steps.

tools.name: get_available_steps
tools.description: Find safe, currently available steps from the dependency graph.

tools.name: complete_step
tools.description: Record the user’s physical completion confirmation only when dependencies and safety checks permit.

tools.name: undo_step
tools.description: Undo a completed step. Explicit cascade confirmation is required to invalidate completed descendants.

tools.name: select_step
tools.description: Select a step and return its actual instructions and dependency status.

tools.name: set_tool_available
tools.description: Report whether an assembly tool is available and recompute the plan.

tools.name: recalculate_plan
tools.description: Recompute dependencies, missing parts, and available alternatives.

tools.name: explain_blockage
tools.description: Explain why progress is blocked and which alternatives remain.

tools.name: get_safety_requirements
tools.description: Read assembly precautions. Software cannot inspect physical installation.

tools.name: focus_3d_part
tools.description: Select a real part in shared state for the 3D client to focus.

tools.name: save_progress
tools.description: Return a portable snapshot. The caller must persist it.

tools.name: restore_progress
tools.description: Validate and restore a caller-provided progress snapshot in this session.

plan.title: Preparar la base
plan.description: Colocá D1 sobre una superficie plana protegida, con los orificios de unión accesibles. Identificá sus bordes y separá las fijaciones.
plan.safety: Trabajá sobre una superficie estable y despejada. Este prototipo no sustituye las instrucciones de un fabricante.

plan.title: Instalar paneles laterales
plan.description: Alineá B1 y B2 con los orificios de D1. Sostené cada panel mientras colocás los conectores S1. Mantené el conjunto apoyado.
plan.safety: Sostené los paneles hasta fijarlos. No cargues el conjunto ni lo dejes de pie sin apoyo antes de instalar B7.

plan.title: Instalar repisa central
plan.description: Con el conjunto apoyado, alineá C1 entre B1 y B2 y fijala con sus soportes S1. Este paso puede realizarse mientras falta B7.
plan.safety: Mantené los laterales apoyados y las manos fuera de los puntos de unión. No cargues la repisa.

plan.title: Fijar travesaño B7
plan.description: Uní B7 horizontalmente entre los laterales, por la parte posterior, debajo de la futura cubierta. Usá las fijaciones S1.
plan.safety: B7 es estructural. No continúes con la cubierta si falta o está dañado; no uses una pieza improvisada.

plan.title: Colocar panel superior
plan.description: Alineá A1 sobre los laterales y el travesaño ya fijados. Instalá sus conectores S1 y ajustá con cuidado.
plan.safety: Verificá manualmente las uniones de C1 y B7 antes de apoyar A1. No aprietes en exceso.

plan.title: Preparar los cuatro pies
plan.description: Sobre la mesa de trabajo, prepará las placas y protectores de F1 con S1. Dejá los cuatro pies separados del mueble, listos para fijar.
plan.safety: Los pies se preparan por separado. No intentes voltear ni sostener el mueble incompleto para colocarlos.

plan.title: Fijar pies a la base
plan.description: Con el conjunto completo y apoyado de forma segura sobre una superficie protegida, fijá los cuatro pies preparados en los puntos de D1.
plan.safety: Pedí ayuda para mover el conjunto si no podés sujetarlo cómodamente. Nunca trabajes debajo de un mueble sostenido a mano.

plan.title: Revisión final
plan.description: Colocá el mueble en suelo plano. Revisá manualmente todas las uniones, que los cuatro pies apoyen y que no haya movimiento inesperado.
plan.safety: La app registra tu confirmación; no verifica la resistencia física. No te subas, no lo uses como asiento ni lo cargues sin una capacidad validada.

tools.name: preview_scenario
tools.description: Read-only counterfactual resource and progress analysis. Returns a validated hypothetical copy and exact base token; never changes actual inventory, confirmations or audit.

tools.name: compare_scenarios
tools.description: Compare one to six independent counterfactuals against the same actual snapshot using the real dependency planner.

tools.name: explain_recovery
tools.description: Read actual or hypothetical graph-derived resource requirements and prerequisite work. This does not certify physical safety or optimize repair order.

tools.name: apply_scenario
tools.description: Atomically apply reviewed resource changes and digital confirmation invalidation. Requires explicit client human approval and an exact unchanged base token; rejects stale proposals.

tools.name: load_assembly
tools.description: Load a catalog assembly in this isolated session. Resets this session only.

tools.name: get_assembly_state
tools.description: Read this session’s current assembly and action history.

tools.name: list_parts
tools.description: List original model parts and their inventory states.

tools.name: inspect_part
tools.description: Inspect and select a part by its identifier.

tools.name: explain_part_impact
tools.description: Compute the dependency impact of a hypothetical missing part without changing inventory.

tools.name: mark_part_missing
tools.description: Report a missing part and invalidate dependent assembly steps.

tools.name: restore_part
tools.description: Report a recovered part and recompute valid next steps.

tools.name: get_available_steps
tools.description: Find safe, currently available steps from the dependency graph.

tools.name: complete_step
tools.description: Record the user’s physical completion confirmation only when dependencies and safety checks permit.

tools.name: undo_step
tools.description: Undo a completed step. Explicit cascade confirmation is required to invalidate completed descendants.

tools.name: select_step
tools.description: Select a step and return its actual instructions and dependency status.

tools.name: set_tool_available
tools.description: Report whether an assembly tool is available and recompute the plan.

tools.name: recalculate_plan
tools.description: Recompute dependencies, missing parts, and available alternatives.

tools.name: explain_blockage
tools.description: Explain why progress is blocked and which alternatives remain.

tools.name: get_safety_requirements
tools.description: Read assembly precautions. Software cannot inspect physical installation.

tools.name: focus_3d_part
tools.description: Select a real part in shared state for the 3D client to focus.

tools.name: save_progress
tools.description: Return a portable snapshot. The caller must persist it.

tools.name: restore_progress
tools.description: Validate and restore a caller-provided progress snapshot in this session.

plan.title: Preparar la base
plan.description: Colocá D1 sobre una superficie plana protegida, con los orificios de unión accesibles. Identificá sus bordes y separá las fijaciones.
plan.safety: Trabajá sobre una superficie estable y despejada. Este prototipo no sustituye las instrucciones de un fabricante.

plan.title: Instalar paneles laterales
plan.description: Alineá B1 y B2 con los orificios de D1. Sostené cada panel mientras colocás los conectores S1. Mantené el conjunto apoyado.
plan.safety: Sostené los paneles hasta fijarlos. No cargues el conjunto ni lo dejes de pie sin apoyo antes de instalar B7.

plan.title: Instalar repisa central
plan.description: Con el conjunto apoyado, alineá C1 entre B1 y B2 y fijala con sus soportes S1. Este paso puede realizarse mientras falta B7.
plan.safety: Mantené los laterales apoyados y las manos fuera de los puntos de unión. No cargues la repisa.

plan.title: Fijar travesaño B7
plan.description: Uní B7 horizontalmente entre los laterales, por la parte posterior, debajo de la futura cubierta. Usá las fijaciones S1.
plan.safety: B7 es estructural. No continúes con la cubierta si falta o está dañado; no uses una pieza improvisada.

plan.title: Colocar panel superior
plan.description: Alineá A1 sobre los laterales y el travesaño ya fijados. Instalá sus conectores S1 y ajustá con cuidado.
plan.safety: Verificá manualmente las uniones de C1 y B7 antes de apoyar A1. No aprietes en exceso.

plan.title: Preparar los cuatro pies
plan.description: Sobre la mesa de trabajo, prepará las placas y protectores de F1 con S1. Dejá los cuatro pies separados del mueble, listos para fijar.
plan.safety: Los pies se preparan por separado. No intentes voltear ni sostener el mueble incompleto para colocarlos.

plan.title: Fijar pies a la base
plan.description: Con el conjunto completo y apoyado de forma segura sobre una superficie protegida, fijá los cuatro pies preparados en los puntos de D1.
plan.safety: Pedí ayuda para mover el conjunto si no podés sujetarlo cómodamente. Nunca trabajes debajo de un mueble sostenido a mano.

plan.title: Revisión final
plan.description: Colocá el mueble en suelo plano. Revisá manualmente todas las uniones, que los cuatro pies apoyen y que no haya movimiento inesperado.
plan.safety: La app registra tu confirmación; no verifica la resistencia física. No te subas, no lo uses como asiento ni lo cargues sin una capacidad validada.
